Pankaj Singh Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17
November, 2023
Author: Krishan Pahal

Bench: Krishan Pahal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:218630
Court No. - 72
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 5204 of 2023
Applicant :- Pankaj Singh Yadav

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Yadavendra Dwivedi,Shashi Kant Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Sumit Kumar Srivastava
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.
2.Heard Mr. Shashi Kant Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. Yogesh Mishra, learned A.G.A. for the State and also perused the record.

None is present on behalf of opposite party no.2.
3.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Complaint Case No.140 of 2021 "X vs. Pankaj Singh Yadav", under Section- 376 of IPC, Police Station- Colonelganj, District- Prayagraj, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As per prosecution story, the victim and the applicant were in a relationship and wanted to marry each other, but the same could not take place.
Later on, the same was solemnized on 24.08.2023, as such the Investigating Officer submitted a closure report in the said case.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that somehow a misunderstanding took place between the parties and they fell apart, as such the victim filed a protest petition to the said closure report.
The case was treated as complaint case and the applicant has been summoned by the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.18, Allahabad vide order dated 10.10.2022.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.18, Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel further stated that the allegations are per-se false.
Learned counsel has also stated that there are no allegations for administering any poisonous material to the victim and there is no injury report to support it.
The applicant is ready to co-operate during trial.
The applicant was granted interim protection by this Court vide order dated 16.05.2023 and he has not misused it.
6. Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
It is further submitted that the applicant has no criminal history.
In case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed, he will not misuse the liberty and shall cooperate with trial.

7. On the other hand, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicant and also the fact that the applicant has no criminal history.

8. Considering the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and in view of the law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98", the applicant is entitled to be granted anticipatory bail in this case.

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9. Without expressing any opinion upon ultimate merits of the case either ways which may adversely affect the trial of the case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.

entities.text: Pankaj Singh Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 11. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.

12. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.

(Justice Krishan Pahal) Order Date :- 17.11.2023 Saif  Pankaj Singh Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11912675/
